description: Unit tests for the 'Item Group' doctype in ERPNext, focusing on nested set hierarchy operations such as moving, merging, deleting, and rebuilding item group trees.

classes.name: TestItem
classes.description: Test case class for item group hierarchy operations, including tree validation, movement, deletion, and merging.

methods.name: test_basic_tree
methods.description: Validates the nested set properties of item groups, ensuring correct lft/rgt values and child counts.

methods.name: get_no_of_children
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of children for a given item group.

methods.name: test_recursion
methods.description: Tests detection of recursive parent-child relationships.

methods.name: test_rebuild_tree
methods.description: Rebuilds the item group tree and validates structure.

methods.name: move_it_back
methods.description: Resets item group hierarchy to original state.

methods.name: test_move_group_into_another
methods.description: Tests moving an item group under another parent and validates lft/rgt adjustments.

methods.name: test_move_group_into_root
methods.description: Tests error when moving a group into root when multiple roots are not allowed.

methods.name: print_tree
methods.description: Outputs current item group tree structure.

methods.name: test_move_leaf_into_another_group
methods.description: Tests moving a leaf node into another group and validates rgt adjustments.

methods.name: test_delete_leaf
methods.description: Deletes a leaf node and verifies ancestor rgt values update.

methods.name: test_delete_group
methods.description: Ensures deletion of a group with children raises an error.

methods.name: test_merge_groups
methods.description: Merges two item groups and validates tree structure.

methods.name: test_merge_leaves
methods.description: Merges leaf nodes and validates tree structure.

methods.name: test_merge_leaf_into_group
methods.description: Checks error when merging a leaf into a group.

methods.name: test_merge_group_into_leaf
methods.description: Checks error when merging a group into a leaf.
